correctness.rationale: The \(x=y\) substitution in characteristic two forces square-zero images, and the natural-basis squares are independent, hence all operator images lie in the annihilator. The algebra automorphism family is derived by recursively squaring \(\phi(e_1)\) and imposing zero mixed products. Direct conjugation gives the affine/scaling coefficient action. Orbit–stabilizer and \(\gcd(2^r-1,2^s-1)=2^{\gcd(r,s)}-1\) give every support class. Burnside applied to the cyclic multiplicative group gives the divisor-sum. The attached verifier enumerates complete automorphism groups for \((q,n)=(2,3),(4,2)\), and actual coefficient-vector conjugation orbits for ten small \((q,n)\) instances, including all vectors up to \(q=8,n=4\); VERIFY_OK. These finite checks do not prove arbitrary \(e,n\) and the symbolic proof is primary.

value.rationale: For a natural infinite family of nilpotent evolution algebras, the previously known vector-space count \(q^n\) is refined into a complete moduli/orbit stratification. Exact stabilizers reveal when extra finite-field symmetries arise from \(\gcd(e,n-i)\), and the divisor-sum formula gives all orbits and all support sizes for arbitrary extension degree and chain length. Such conjugacy data permit effective enumeration of inequivalent operator structures, beyond a routine repackaging of the operator cardinality. This value does not depend on an unproved downstream theorem.
